{{Quote|Of course, the Empire found out about the operation when one of my own men turned out to be a traitor. If not for the efforts of a daring Rebel strike team, we might not have escaped Roche system with the starfighters, let alone our lives and the lives of the Verpine.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Roche''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the months following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] and [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] engineers worked in the [[Roche asteroid field]] in order to develop the new [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]]. However, after learning that the [[Shantipole Project|project]] was nearing completion, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[District Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] instituted a [[blockade of the Roche system]] and attacked the [[Research Station Shantipole]] to recover the prototypes.<ref name="SFS" />
